description: Close the loop after an agent executes: issue a signed execution-price receipt from the pre-trade handle plus the settlement transaction, or settle a guarded Base/Solana swap. Use it only after the trade settled. Do not use it before execution and do not treat the verdict as principal authorization. Returns a signed receipt or settlement with FAITHFUL/DEVIATED/NOT_EXECUTED/UNDETERMINED (or settlement status), price delta, binding ids and verify URL.

decision.description: Required for settle modes; the signed guard decision

receipt.description: Required for mode=receipt; old execution_receipt fields

name: issue_execution_receipt
